questions.prompt: Sometimes referred to as secret shoppers, mystery shoppers 11 regular customers to purchase items, eat in restaurants, make inquiries, or return items.
questions.explanation: 【句型】pose as 指「假扮成」，表示神祕客「假扮成」一般顧客去購買商品；call for（需要）、attend to（處理）、engage in（從事）都不合。

questions.prompt: They grade and report on the quality of products, customer service, and environment of the stores 12 they are assigned.
questions.explanation: the stores to which they are assigned（他們被分配到的商店），關係代名詞 which 代替 stores，介系詞 to 來自 assigned to 這個字詞搭配；in that（因為）、with which（assigned 是 assigned to 不是 assigned with）、for that 都不合。

questions.prompt: When evaluating a business, mystery shoppers have to follow certain standard procedures to avoid 13 .
questions.explanation: 語意「必須遵循一定的標準程序以避免『個人偏見』」，personal bias（個人偏見）符合，呼應後文提供 checklist 確保評估一致性的目的；keen competitions（激烈競爭）、financial hardship（財務困難）、racial conflicts（種族衝突）都不合。

questions.prompt: They may also pretend to be 14 customers, arguing with a salesperson without a good reason.
questions.explanation: difficult 形容人時是「難相處的、難搞的」，a difficult customer 即「奧客」，與後面的分詞構句 arguing with a salesperson without a good reason 完全吻合；potential（潛在的）、constant（持續不斷的）、anonymous（匿名的）都不合。

questions.prompt: With the data they collect, mystery shoppers can identify areas for 15 and thereby help enhance the quality of products and services.
questions.explanation: 【句型】areas for improvement 指「待改進之處」；distribution（分配）、expectation（期望）、management（管理）都不合。

questions.prompt: None of them had any idea they were about to create a social innovation that 11 rapidly around the world.
questions.explanation: 過去未來式 would spread，站在 1995 年那個過去時間點，描述接下來將發生的事（他們沒想到這個創新後來會快速傳播到世界各地），是「過去看未來」的時態；had spread（過去完成式，時態方向不合，這是講「未來會發生」不是「已經發生過」）、had been spreading（同樣時態方向不合）、would have spread（與過去事實相反的假設語氣，這裡不是假設）都不合。

questions.prompt: With their plan 12 by the rain, the two dozen participants squeezed into the living room.
questions.explanation: with + 受詞 + 受詞補語（表附帶狀態），With their plan disrupted by the rain（他們的計畫被雨打亂了），過去分詞 disrupted 表被動；facilitated（被促進，語意相反）、disclosed（被揭露）、fulfilled（被實現，語意相反）都不合。

questions.prompt: They periodically stopped their conversations to switch tables so the insights and ideas might 13 and deepen.
questions.explanation: circulate 是「流通、傳布」，本句指與會者換桌讓見解與想法得以流通並深化；emphasize（強調）、recover（恢復）、preserve（保存）語意都不合。

questions.prompt: Over the course of the morning, the innovative discussion process 14 a new form of collective effort that transformed the depth, scope, and quality of their discussion.
questions.explanation: 【句型】give rise to 指「引發/產生」，表示這個創新的討論過程「催生了」一種新形式的集體協作；made up for（彌補）、kept track of（追蹤）、looked out for（留意）都不合。
語意「世界咖啡館『就此』誕生了」，thus（就此/因此）承接前面描述的整個過程，作為結果的總結；still（仍然）、also（也）、further（進一步）都不合。

questions.prompt: White rhinoceroses, 11 , do the same thing—only their choice of meeting place is a giant pile of poop.
questions.explanation: it turns out 作插入語，意為「結果發現、原來」，用來帶出出乎意料的事實——白犀牛竟然也和人類一樣會聚集交流；what is more（更有甚者）、in other words（換句話說）、all in all（總而言之）都不帶「意外」的語氣。

questions.prompt: A new study indicates that rhinos have a smelly way to 12 .
questions.explanation: 語意「犀牛有一種很臭的方式來『溝通』」，communicate（溝通）符合，呼應前文提到分享最新消息的類比；demonstrate（展示）、immigrate（移民）、manipulate（操縱）都不合。

questions.prompt: Furthermore, different rhinos leave different chemicals in their poop, which provide important 13 about the age, sex, general health, and reproductive conditions of each specific rhino.
questions.explanation: 語意「提供關於年齡、性別……的重要『線索』」，clues（線索）符合這種透過化學物質推測資訊的語境；doubts（疑慮）、icons（圖示）、matches（比賽/火柴）都不合。

questions.prompt: When all members in a group know what's going on with each other, it is 14 that they will fight.
questions.explanation: 語意「當群體成員彼此了解狀況時，牠們打架的可能性就『比較低』」，less likely 符合，呼應前文說明糞便訊息有助於群體和諧；hardly surprising（不太令人驚訝）、more acceptable（更可接受）、truly important（真的重要）都不合。

questions.prompt: They find that dominant males are particularly 15 the “fake poop” that carries chemicals from females ready to mate.
questions.explanation: 【句型】responsive to 指「對……有反應」，表示優勢雄性對帶有雌性化學物質的假糞便特別「有反應」；annoyed at（對……生氣）、considerate of（體貼）、tolerant with（容忍）都不合。
